arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various alignment scenarios
print('Testing alignment...')

# Left aligned
r = parse.parse('{:<}', 'hello   ')
print('  {:<} with \"hello   \":', r.fixed if r else None)

# Right aligned
r2 = parse.parse('{:>}', '   hello')
print('  {:>} with \"   hello\":', r2.fixed if r2 else None)

# Center aligned
r3 = parse.parse('{:^}', '  hello  ')
print('  {:^} with \"  hello  \":', r3.fixed if r3 else None)

# Named field with alignment
r4 = parse.parse('{name:<}', 'hello   ')
print('  {name:<} with \"hello   \":', r4.named if r4 else None)

# Mixed named/unnamed with alignment
r5 = parse.parse('{:<},{:>', '12 ,34 ')
print('  {:<},{:> with \"12 ,34 \":', r5.fixed if r5 else None)
"
